body_html: Zahir (DJ Breezy) Hollins-Thomas joins the JAMMIN’ DJs team from Newark, NJ! Bringing us that east coast flair, Breezy has been DJing and had a passion for music since High School.  He is a high energy DJ and emcee, and loves crowd interaction.  When he is not DJing, Zahir loves the Skating Rink community, singing, and educating others. What’s in Breezy’s Headphones?  “I love to listen and vibe to all genres of music.” What’s the best part of being a DJ?  “I love seeing the smiles that music creates.  I love how people enjoy the music being played” What are your favorite types of events to DJ?  Weddings, Community Events
